protocol.task: Rosmaster recorded-start cube lift and stable carry at 20 Hz
protocol.selection: Final weights at fixed update budgets. Open confirmation after at least one new learned planner attains a terminal hold on development. Evaluate every declared arm including negative results. No checkpoint selection on confirmation.
protocol.controls: Constant substitutes the mean XY of the same 32 training points in each matched architecture. RBF uses the frozen SciPy thin-plate recipe. IK uses the vendor solver. Both neural policies predict eight PCA coefficients and share the same training-only decoder. DDIM uses fixed initial noise. All seven arms share the RGB observation, look, rate limits, reset and existing task scorer.
protocol.terminal: held_in_carry_pose for the simulator-configured stable interval
protocol.contact_sampling: At 20 Hz after each control step, score contacts between the cube and a left/right gripper link. Bilateral requires both sides in the same sample. Peak lift relative to reset cube height. No contact or simulator target position enters policy inference.
protocol.historical_comparison: The old RGB ACT-25 and Diffusion used raw images/joint feedback from reset. Match their recorded initial arm and cube vectors and physics on the same historical seeds. The new systems also have a deliberate camera look, a supervised localizer and a compressive action representation. This comparison measures a pipeline change.
